payload.name: Photo 180x240 Under 50KB by PrintableTools Lab
payload.short_description: Free no-signup 180 x 240 photo workflow for 50KB upload limits.
payload.long_description: A free browser-based 180 x 240 photo under 50KB workflow for application, school, profile, and exam portals that require exact portrait pixels plus a small KB cap. It points to local resize and image-to-KB compression steps, requires no account and no server file upload, and includes an optional USD 9 Upload Limit Fix Plan request after a public-safe fit check.
